tp4-ar.qualification: Not qualified: the M1 bring-up profile, autoregressive at TP4 on the deepseek-ai checkpoint with the native KV layout, which kv_cache_dtype auto serves. The BF16 KV layout is not a served profile: it is qual.json's kv-bf16 comparison configuration, not qualified for capacity, preemption under pressure or offload. Its evidence is the release preview's full suite at the release revision (models/deepseek41/README.md#qualification). Prefill runs exact upper-layer dependency intervals at guaranteed 8192-token chunk ends, prompt ends and response ends, bitwise equal to the full schedule; prefix anchors exist only at those ends, so a partial prefix hit recomputes up to 8128 rows. The matching -full-prefill profile keeps the full schedule.

tp4-dspark.qualification: Not qualified: DSpark at TP4 on the deepseek-ai checkpoint with native KV. The five-row backbone computes all five heads except uniform depth-three batches of 3-8 items, which compute the used prefix. Qualification requires AR and speculative arms, exact greedy equality, the declared speculative-verification bounds and GSM8K at least 193 of 200 in each arm. Prefill runs exact upper-layer dependency intervals at guaranteed 8192-token chunk ends, prompt ends and response ends, bitwise equal to the full schedule; prefix anchors exist only at those ends, so a partial prefix hit recomputes up to 8128 rows. The matching -full-prefill profile keeps the full schedule. DSpark prefill batches commit projections and overlaps per-layer Engram gathers by default. Set CHOPINFER_DSPARK_BATCHED_COMMIT=0 or CHOPINFER_DEEPSEEK41_PREFILL_ENGRAM=0 to disable the corresponding path.
